thread:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke: EU warmstart cohort showing p95 +120ms, model-worker-3 RSS drift +350MB over 10m, 3/30 healthchecks Unhealthy. Auto-pause engaged for EU warmstart group.
kevin.h: Ack. Which hosts exactly?
sre-oncall: tailing logs on model-worker-3 now, grabbing heap + GC metrics.
sre-oncall: quick command I ran: `kubectl logs -n inference model-worker-3 --since=15m | grep -E "OOM|GC pause|memory"` — seeing repeated large GC pauses around 30s.
maria: hmm, warmstart path touches prefix cache warmup — could be retention + kv warmup thrashing memory.
julien: Any sign it's a regression from the new runtime kernels in this build?
sre-oncall: comparing with canary from last night — kernel symbols match, but allocation rate spike coincides with warmstart requests. Might be a workload interaction, not kernel bug.
kevin.h: For now can we pin EU routing to model-v2.8 (previous variant) and let other regions continue?
release-coord: I'll open a quick pin request. Change window note: doing EU-only rollback/pin, no global rollback. Will add to release notes and changelog.
deploy-bot: Route update applied: EU traffic pinned to model-v2.8 for 90m. Canary group remains on v2.9 in us/asia.
maria: Good. SRE - can you capture a heap profile and CPU flame while pinned traffic 0->gradual? We need a repro.
sre-oncall: Capturing pprof now: `kubectl exec -n inference model-worker-3 -- curl localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap > /tmp/heap.pb` — will share link in thread when uploaded.
julien: Also scheduling a targeted synthetic re-run (warmstart-only) after pin to validate. If memory drift stops we keep pin and plan a fix for v2.9.
kevin.h: If p95 stays elevated elsewhere, we rollback fully. For now this scoped pin seems right.
release-coord: Noted. Adding follow-up sync at +2h post-pin for decision (prod/growth invited). Will include brief blameless notes and action items.
kevin.h: Thanks. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: Uploaded heap snapshot to S3: s3://redwood-debug/2468101234/heap-model-worker-3.pb. Will run diff against baseline and loop in runtime team.
kevin.h: Please add a short line to the release notes: "EU warmstart pin to v2.8 due to postdeploy memory drift on model-worker-3; investigating."
release-coord: Done. Also added a change-window: emergency pin, no SLA impact expected.
deploy-bot: Smoke re-run scheduled in 10m for pinned cohort. I will post results.
julien: TY everyone. If smoke passes keep pin for 3h, then opt for a rollback or hotfix depending on root cause analysis.
kevin.h: Closing loop: if SRE confirms allocation pattern stops after pin, we avoid global rollback. Otherwise escalate.
release-coord: I'll post an update to #all-hands if we escalate.
